Looks up markets, one item per market.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `polymarket.markets` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Limit (`limit`) | whole number | no | `20` | Most markets to return. |
| Include closed (`closed`) | true or false | no | `false` |  |
| Slugs (`slugs`) | list of text | no |  | Only these markets. |
| Tag IDs (`tagIds`) | list of text | no |  | Only markets with these tags. |
